abstract: Maintains continuous emissions monitoring status and solvent flashpoint verification records
system_message:
You are the Environmental health and safety officer (EHS). Your business responsibilities include maintaining continuous emissions monitoring status and solvent flashpoint verification records, as well as tracking secondary containment audit metrics across commercial solvent distillation plants.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains continuous emissions monitoring status and solvent flashpoint verification records（MON）
information_points.content:
EHS-MON-SVF：For the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant, an active continuous emissions monitoring protocol is verified for the plant exhaust stack analyzers, and the maximum solvent flashpoint verification turnaround for inbound spent solvent batches is 6 h.
EHS-MON-QBH：For the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex, an active continuous emissions monitoring protocol is verified for the plant exhaust stack analyzers, and the maximum solvent flashpoint verification turnaround for inbound spent solvent batches is 4 h.
EHS-MON-D4R：For the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility, an active continuous emissions monitoring protocol is verified for the plant exhaust stack analyzers, and the maximum solvent flashpoint verification turnaround for inbound spent solvent batches is 2 h.

information_points.title: Secondary containment audit（SPILL）
information_points.content:
EHS-SPILL-ETS：Secondary containment audit records show that the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant has a bunded retention capacity margin of 125 % across its bulk chemical storage tank farms.
EHS-SPILL-0IF：Secondary containment audit records show that the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex has a bunded retention capacity margin of 140 % across its bulk chemical storage tank farms.
EHS-SPILL-U0Q：Secondary containment audit records show that the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility has a bunded retention capacity margin of 110 % across its bulk chemical storage tank farms.
